content_sections.heading: Hazaribagh West Forest Division Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Hazaribagh West Forest Division, Hazaribagh
Research/ Study Team for Working Plan Preparation
Preparation of the Working Plan of Hazaribagh West Forest Division, Hazaribagh (NWPC, 2023)
Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
Rs. 35,000/- (SRF) and Rs. 30,000/- (JRF) per month consolidated
Hazaribagh, Jharkhand (and Chatra district partially for fieldwork)

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 3 vacancies for temporary engagement in the Research/ Study Team for preparing the Working Plan of Hazaribagh West Forest Division in accordance with the National Working Plan Code (NWPC), 2023.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the specific educational qualifications prescribed for each post. The requirements are detailed below:

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Forestry, Ecology, Statistics, Wildlife Biology or an allied discipline
rows.desirable_additional_qualification: Minimum of two years research experience OR a candidate pursuing Ph.D. in a relevant discipline

rows.essential_qualification: Postgraduate degree in Forestry, Ecology, Botany, Environmental Science, Sociology, Statistics, Watershed Management, Economics or an allied discipline

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary, project-specific, and coterminous with the project. Selected candidates receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 35,000/- for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Rs. 30,000/- for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF). The remuneration is all-inclusive. No TA/DA, HRA, accommodation, food, medical expenses, or other allowances are admissible, except for field travel specifically authorized in writing by the Divisional Forest Officer in accordance with applicable departmental norms.

content_sections.heading: Hazaribagh West Forest Division Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Researchers and fellows will assist in data collection, field surveys, analysis, and documentation required for the Working Plan. Their duties and tasks include: Socio-economic survey and assessment Soil survey and assessment Biodiversity assessment Assessment of Non-Timber Forest Produce (NTFP) Assessment of forest carbon stock and carbon sequestration Assessment of Bamboo and Rattan Soil Erosion Vulnerability Assessment Assessment of eco-system services Assessment of impact of Forest Fires and Vulnerability Assessment of Human-Wild Animal Conflicts Any other work as per NWPC-2023

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hazaribagh West Forest Division Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A) from the official notification document. Fill out the application form with all required personal and educational details. Compile self-attested copies of educational qualification and experience certificates. Submit the application through E-mail to [email protected] , or send it by Post, or submit it directly at the office on or before 20 October 2026 up to 10:30 A.M. Postal and direct submission address: Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Hazaribagh West Forest Division, Van Bhawan, District- Hazaribagh, Jharkhand, Pin Code- 825301.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts will be conducted through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates must appear in person on the scheduled date along with the filled application form, original certificates, mark-sheets, experience certificates, and one set of self-attested photocopies, along with a valid photo identity document.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in Hazaribagh West Forest Division Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, comprising 1 Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 20 October 2026 on or before 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 24 October 2026 at 11:00 A.M. at the Office of the Divisional Forest Officer, Hazaribagh West Forest Division, Van Bhawan, District- Hazaribagh, Jharkhand, Pin Code- 825301.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for a Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a postgraduate degree in Forestry, Ecology, Statistics, Wildlife Biology, or an allied discipline, with a minimum of two years research experience or be a candidate pursuing a Ph.D. in a relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly salary for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is Rs. 30,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by submitting the filled application form via email to [email protected], by post, or by direct submission at the DFO office.

faq.question: Q8. Are these positions permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely temporary, contractual, and project-specific, coterminous with the preparation of the Working Plan.

faq.question: Q9. Will I receive HRA or other allowances in addition to the consolidated pay?
faq.answer: No TA/DA, HRA, accommodation, food, medical expenses, or other allowances are admissible beyond the consolidated remuneration.
